project: TCMC Service Expansion via La Crosse

project: Gulf Coast Passenger Rail
Amtrak service east of New Orleans has been suspended since Hurricane Katrina. In 2025, the Mardi Gras route restores service along part of the original route.
routes.name: Mardi Gras Service

project: Atlanta to Savannah Corridor
Georgia's first state-supported route would connect inland Atlanta to coastal Savannah by way of Athens/Augusta or Macon.
routes.name: Atlanta - Savannah

project: Atlanta-Memphis Corridor
The proposed route would run between Atlanta and Memphis with stops in Chattanooga and Nashville, one of the largest cities with no passenger rail.
routes.name: Atlanta - Memphis

project: Boston and Albany Corridor

Most of Massachusetts' largest population centers sit along a straight line spanning the length of the state. A new state-supported route would supplement the existing Lake Shore Limited, increasing service from one to as many as eight daily round trips.
routes.name: Boston - Albany

project: Charlotte to Kings Mountain Corridor
This project aims to improve capacity along a small stretch of the Charlotte-Atlanta corridor by adding infill stations and a new service reaching as far as Kings Mountain.

Louisville has not seen intercity rail service since Amtrak's Kentucky Cardinal was discontinued in the Early 2000s. A restoration of this route would connect the city to Indianapolis and Chicago while supplementing the Cardinal between the two.

The Quad Cities project aims to reactivate the Rock Island line with the goal of supporting Amtrak service to Moline.

project: Colorado Front Range Corridor

project: Central Coast Corridor
The only connection between Southern California and the Bay Area is the once-a-day Coast Starlight route. A new service would supplement this corridor with more daily round trips.
